content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW), fallback target.**

- **Responsive locations:** § 14.3 (p0123) is the only governing-law/forum clause; § 12.2 (p0105) cross-refers to it for escrow disputes. No other dispute-resolution or venue language exists in the document.
- **Analysis:** California law is acceptable at the fallback level, so the law element is already met verbatim. However, the forum is mandatory AAA arbitration before a single arbitrator in San Francisco — not the "corresponding California courts" the fallback requires. Because the seat is domestic, this is a fallback failure rather than walk-away.
- **Cure (smallest complete change):** replaced only the arbitration mechanic in § 14.3 with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in San Francisco County, California (retaining the California choice-of-law sentence verbatim), and conformed the § 12.2 cross-reference so it no longer points to a deleted arbitration procedure or the now-removed "RULES" definition. No preferred-only extras (New York venue, temporary-injunction carve-out) were volunteered.
